Each project in this portfolio is structured as a **unified 3-act validation paper** fusing **First-Line Quantitative Modeling** (mathematical loss estimation, parameter calibration, stress testing) with **Second-Line Model Risk Management** (independent challenger benchmarking, boundary invariants, and **SR 11-7 / OSFI E-23** governance synthesis). Every paper pairs directly with an audited code repository or interactive application.
